title: Peer release accuracy, ACadSharp failure shapes, and FreeCAD/ACIS evidence ceilings
mode: Read-only primary-source research and local-plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Recheck LibreDWG release-versus-historical NEWS attribution, current writer caveats, and the build-scoped AcDs/SAB issue report.
Refresh ACadSharp's version/direction matrix and current parser, writer, TABLE, MLEADER, VERTEX, EED, and MTEXT issue shapes.
Verify FreeCAD's converter/importer path and stock ACIS limitations, plus ezdxf's ACIS API and semantic ceilings.
Map evidence to existing libdxfrw owners and make the optional comparison/native gates implementation-ready without increasing per-slice cost.

sources.name: LibreDWG NEWS 0.14.1 / 0.14 and historical v0.11 section
sources.evidence: 0.14.1 documents parser/security changes and a final inline-SAT-block DXF export fix; 0.14 documents R2004 DWG writing and R2007 fallback to R2010. The AcDsPrototype_1b incomplete/brute-force SAB wording is under the historical v0.11 (2020) heading.

sources.name: LibreDWG README and issue #1411
sources.evidence: The README's broad writer guidance is not aligned with every release note. Issue #1411 reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss for the named 0.14.8593 build; this is not a run against current master.

sources.name: ACadSharp compatibility matrix and open issues
sources.evidence: Directional version declarations and issue-specific reports include repeated DXF recursion (#1281), EED size narrowing (#1282), VERTEX subtype marker (#1279), default TABLE CadValue (#1264), MLEADER context roundtrip (#1277), and frame-only AC1032 MTEXT rejection (#1297).

sources.name: FreeCAD Draft DXF and DWG import documentation
sources.evidence: DWG uses an external converter followed by a selected DXF importer. Importer backends have different documented coverage, and stock DXF import does not read embedded ACIS solids.

sources.name: ezdxf ACIS API, FAQ, and authoring guide
sources.evidence: SAT/SAB APIs cover documented profiles and mesh-origin creation, but ACIS support is limited; unsupported nodes may be lost, and flat-face mesh projection loses curved boundaries.

method.limitations: Mutable upstream pages and reporter/maintainer statements establish declared scope and issue-specific claims, not runtime results for a current artifact. No peer artifact, external geometry, or native consumer was executed.

localCrosswalk.LibreDWG: Correct release attribution; preserve #1411 as REPORTED_AT_0.14.8593 / NOT_RETESTED; exact release/source/build and operation binding remain mandatory.

ACadSharp.1281: Existing iterative parser-progress and repeated-record controls.
ACadSharp.1282: Existing EED length/splitting boundaries; do not copy the peer's signed-short threshold.
ACadSharp.1279: Existing parent-role-aware classic POLYLINE/VERTEX behavior; no generic subtype repair.
ACadSharp.1264: Existing 7G.3d TABLECONTENT typed-value and reference owner.
ACadSharp.1277: Existing DWG object-context and owner-closure route; peer no-op corruption is not a local defect.
ACadSharp.1297: Existing versioned MTEXT writer and strict whole-file/native acceptance route.

localCrosswalk.FreeCAD: Native Linux/Windows qualification remains converter plus intermediate-DXF plus pinned importer; score only its supported 2D/explicit-entity subset. Stock ACIS import is UNSUPPORTED_CONSUMER, not a semantic result.
localCrosswalk.ezdxf: Optional exact-profile carrier/tag comparator only; not arbitrary ACIS round-trip, B-rep semantics, or a DWG reader.
